title: RH PEPEFRONT
summary: Command Pepe squads through a contested crystal basin.
description: An unofficial solo strategy game. Harvest ore, develop your base and win by holding the point or destroying the enemy base. Free local practice is separate from wallet-backed strategic battles and deposited rewards.
controls: Click or drag to select; right-click to move; WASD pans; G/B/R/F/H/E issue orders; P pauses. Touch players use Select all, Tap to move and the order buttons. Wallet orders require confirmation.
